annotations.title: Get the EU certificates of a device

description: List the EU notified-body certificates (from EUDAMED) of one device by slug: certificate number, type, legislation (MDR, IVDR, MDD, IVDD, AIMDD), notified body, issue and expiry dates, status (such as issued, supplemented, suspended, withdrawn) and whether EUDAMED still lists it. Use when the question is about CE certificates, notified bodies or certificate expiry of a known device. Do not use for FDA clearances or approvals (they are authorizations in get_device), for certificates by number, notified body or manufacturer (use search_certificates) or to find the device (use search_devices). Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

slug.description: Device slug: the last part of its https://devicerts.com/devices/<slug> URL, as returned by search_devices or find_device_by_identifier. A full page URL or a device:<slug> id is accepted. e.g. heartstart-frx-defibrillator-p180028
